# Draft:Looking out Of The Lor Starcutter...

Looking Out Of The Lor Starcutter... Is The Upcoming Second Studio Album by American Rapper Latbiu Hookt. The album Serves as a follow up to His previous album Bombarder (2025). It's Scheduled to Release on March 20th, 2026. It Is expected to be solely produced by Latbiu Hookt.
}}
Promotion
On Genius, Latbiu Hookt Started becoming more active informing people about the album and uploading the album page on Genius, And Posted The First Tracklist on Genius' 2026 March Album Release Page.
